notes.title: Recoded Movement System | BETA Photo Mode | New Player Model
notes.content:
Hey! I Know Right?
A Whole Day Since An Update? K Let Me Just Say That This Took Me From 11 Or 12 This Morning To 10pm Today.

Basically The Main Game Got A Major Revamp, Not Done Yet But Still. You Can Now Mess Around With A (Almost) Fully Functional Photo Mode, Still Some Bugs With It.

There Was Also A Revamp With The Cups, You Might Have Kicked Them Around A Bit Before And Saw Ice Coming Out. Well Back When I Made That Code I Didn't Know How To Make It Be So It Was When It Was Upside Down It Leaked, So I Just Made It On Contact.

BUT NOW I Have Made It So It Works Like I Always Wanted It To. This Update Also Revamps The Entire UI For The Main Game And Most Extras. Plus A Revamped Movement System Which Is Also In Beta.
There Are Now Camera Shakes, And Working On Controller Force Feedback To Match With Them.

My storage might be down to 1mb But it is pretty optimized for you guys, And Jeez This Game Is Getting Kinda Fat Ain't It, Thinking By The End Of The Month It'll Be About A Gigabyte.

This games like a playground to make and to play in so I hope you like the new update, I'm gonna test it on a less powerful computer tonight so I can check for bugs. Thanks for playing!!!

- Newboon

notes.title: What's Coming In Final Update 2?
notes.content:
So You Probably Saw 1/3 For The Last Update.

I'm Going To Keep The 3rd Update Mostly A Secret, But I Will Tell You What The Second One Is Because Of How Massive It Will Be For The Game.

I've Been Working On A Script For The Games Story Mode Which Will Be The 2nd Final Update,
The Story Won't Be Too Serious It's Mostly Comedic, I Don't Really Have A Planned Release Date But I Know If A Part Of It Isn't Good - Amazing Or Boring It'll Probably Be Cut Out.

I Will Also Probably Voice Almost ALL Characters.

The Story Mode Won't Be As Family Friendly As The Game Is Normally, There Won't Be Swearing Or Extreme Gore But There Will Be Some Comedic Violence And Barely Even Mild Language.

Since This Is A Big Update It Will Take Some Time, Especially Because I'm Putting As Much Effort Into It As I Can.

You Might Not Know This But I Model Everything In The Game Myself, Which Takes Time.

So Far I Made A Few Walls, A Window And A Door.

No Spoilers So That's All I Will Say.


Other Things Final Update 2 Will Add Is Patches For The Game Itself Like,

Classic Extra In Sandbox Mode,

Updated Town Extra In Sandbox Mode (With Basketball Nets And Basketballs),

Audio Fixes.


That's All For Now,

See Ya

- Newboon

notes.title: Pickup Trash Simulator Final Update (1/3)
notes.content:
This Update Adds The Classic Extra, It Recreates The Look Of How The Original Game Looked.
This Update Is One Of The Three Final Updates Coming Out This Year. This Update Will Be The Smallest Out Of The Three.

One Of The Reasons I'm Leaving Game Development Is Because Of Storage Space, After The Update I Have 362 MB Left In My Drives All Together. Unreal Engine Takes Up A Lot Of Storage Even To Run.
Then To Build Lighting And Levels It's So Much For My PC.

This Update Adds A New Classic Mode And Basketball Hoops By Some Houses In The Town Extra.

notes.title: No Longer Doing Game Development
notes.content:
You Might Have Noticed I Haven't Made Any New Updates On The Game For A While And That's Because I'm Not Going To Make Games Anymore.

I Do A Lot Of Stuff In My Free Time And I Just Thought I Don't Like Game Development Enough To Keep Doing It.

Pickup Trash Simulator Was A Game I Made When I Was 12 For School, It Wasn't That Good.
In The Original Game You Could Walk Through Trees And Flip Upside Down With The Camera, It Was The Same Concept With A Lot Less Cups, Eventually I Added More Trash To The Game And It Made It Worse For Some Reason. That's Why There's No Diversity In The Trash.

I Know This Game Isn't Exactly Amazing But It Took Me 4 Months To Make It, And I Made All Of It Myself.
The Challenge Was To Not Watch Tutorials Making This Game And I Did It, I Made My Own Models All Of The Models In The Game Are Made By Me. Same With The Music And The Code.
Personally I'm Surprised I Even Got This Game On Steam, I Mean It's Not A Terrible Game I Guess But There's Nothing Really To It.

If Your Wondering If I Had Any Projects That I Was Making Before I Said I'm Quitting Yes There Were.
I Have An [url=https://newboon.itch.io]Itch[/url] Page Where They Will Probably All Be On With The Original Pickup Trash Simulator.
So You Can Check Out The Games. No Promises That The Projects Will Be Released.

This Was Always Going To Be The Last Pickup Trash Simulator Game, I Never Was Going To Make Anymore, I Guess I Also Kind Of Though I Wouldn't Make Many More Games After This, I Was Planning On 2 More Games Maybe 1 More On Steam.

I'm Not Quitting Because I Don't Like Game Development Or Because I Feel Like I Can Only Make Bad Games, I'm Quitting Because Of The Time It Takes To Make Games. The Amount Of Time It Takes To Make Something Mediocre Is Just Crazy, I Guess You Could Say I'm Impatient But I Really Just Want To Move On To Other Things.

I Made This Game Because, I Actually Don't Know. I Just Made It To Make It I Guess.

Honestly Playing Games Is More Fun Then Making Them, So Keep Playing And Keep Making.

And You Know What They Say...
[i]Small Games, Small Brains.[/i]

Thanks For Playing My Game And Supporting It,
Who Knows Maybe I'll Even Make Another In 10 Years Or So.

See You Later..

notes.title: 7 Days Until Release
notes.content:
[b]I Hope You[/b] Are All Ready For [i]Pickup Trash Simulator Remastered[/i] To Release To The Public In 7 Days On July 15th.

The Game Is Just Waiting For All Of You To Get Your Hands On It And Start Picking Up Trash. So I Just Wanted To Tell All Of You Who Wishlisted It Or Are Thinking Of Getting It, Thank You.

I May Be A Indie Game Developer Who Goes By Newboon Which Sometimes Gets Auto Corrected To Newborn Which I Think Is Kinda Funny, But Who Cares About That Stuff, You Are Here To Learn About The Funny Trash Game,

[b]Let Me Tell You About It.[/b]

My Game Pickup Trash Simulator Remastered Has ABUNCH Of Extras To Keep You Entertained, Plus Achievements That Can Keep You Playing For A Long While.

I Want You All To Trust Me When I Say This Game Is Worth The Play, Plus It's A New Free Game On Steam There's No Reason Not To Play It,

Well Unless Your On Mac Or Linux.

Completely Honest I Do Have A Working Version Of The Game For [b]Linux[/b] BUT It's Not Ready For Release On [u]July 15th[/u] 2024, So Expect It To Release Later On As In [b][i]Late Q3[/i][/b] Which Is Just An Estimate Because The Linux Version Isn't Fully Optimized Or Tested Fully Either So I'd Like To Ask You Be Patient Linux Users.
Sorry [i]Mac[/i] Users.

[b]7 More Days Until Release,[/b]



[b][i]"Small Games, Small Brains."[/i][/b] -[b]Newboon[/b] [b]2022[/b]
